historical_context.time_period: 2721, three weeks after the fixture-local Kappa Refusal during the Pallas Species Strikes
historical_context.location: Stores Collar Six at the counterspinward entrance to Service Ring Kappa, AU Yard Twelve, Pallas Bloom Cluster.
historical_context.summary: A mixed Kappa work group rebuilds a strike-safe bypass from separately budgeted parts. AU's service-default notice recalls the consumables and freezes claimshare access just as a local condensate fault tests whether workers can preserve air without surrendering their refusal.

public_facts.text: A strike-safe bypass buys temporary air, pressure, condensate, or coolant margin; it is not indefinite replacement life support.
The kit's parts normally belong to separate inventories, so its operational identity appears only when workers assemble and coordinate them.
AU Ramp Administrations control maintenance budgets, safety exceptions, replacement machinery, schedules, and claimshare access while different labor categories share one physical system.
Dry-operation cephalopod specialists require mobile humidity, oxygenation, pressure, support, and utility-coupling equipment to work in cramped human-designed service arteries.
VitaForge biodrones, BioElevate uplift lines, baseline riggers, and AU supervisors can occupy the same yard while employers route identical refusals through different liability categories.

ambient_pressures.text: Using the bypass consumes cartridges, tubing, seal stock, inspection labor, and body-support margin, making the next emergency poorer unless replacements move.
A service default can become a stores restriction, claimshare hold, household pressure, and coerced return to work without any office explicitly ordering a worker to risk the unsafe route.
The worker counter-pressure is quiet distributed custody: different crews hold components and reciprocal obligations so one administrative seizure cannot erase all safety margin.

groups.label: Kappa mixed work group
institutional_logic: Keep the stoppage safe by joining body access, route memory, anchor geometry, ordinary stock, and local authorization.
material_incentives: Avoid concentrating debt on one worker
Retain enough claimshare access for households
internal_shames: Leaving one worker as the debtor for collective safety
prestige_markers: A bypass assembled before the margin turns red
A route map another body can use
Parts distributed without losing deployment speed
taboo_triggers: Support equipment treated as optional comfort
One labor category taking credit for a mixed repair
emotional_display_norms: Concern appears as checking cuffs, counting parts, countersigning losses, and jokes narrow enough to fit through a service hatch.
trust_defaults: Trusts workers who expose their own material stake
Distrusts clean issue records that omit who can physically deploy the equipment

groups.label: AU Yard Twelve Ramp Administration
institutional_logic: Preserve throughput by controlling budgets, issue authority, safety exceptions, and the classification of nonperformance.
material_incentives: Move scarce cartridges to centrally controlled stock
Make one account responsible for disputed use
Prevent claimshares from becoming portable claims against AU
internal_shames: A locally safe stoppage outside management custody
A written order visibly causing a later shortage
prestige_markers: A repayment schedule that replaces open conflict
taboo_triggers: An assembly with no single debtor
Local route knowledge outranking the supervisor bus
emotional_display_norms: Fear appears as calm classification, recall orders, and offers to restore access on revised terms.
trust_defaults: Trusts central issue and assigned liability
Distrusts distributed custody and unpriced mutual aid

groups.label: Supplier liability channels
institutional_logic: Keep each body, support system, and component failure inside its own product or service category.
material_incentives: Charge inspection and replacement to the issuing contract
internal_shames: A work refusal linking separated invoices into one labor system
A support failure visible as coercion
prestige_markers: A fault returned to the buyer
A variance contained to one line
taboo_triggers: Workers using vendor boundaries as an organizing map
emotional_display_norms: No emotion is recorded; discomfort becomes variance, misuse, or local character.

cultural_pressure_fields.summary: The work group must keep downstream air safe without letting management use civilian safety to end every refusal.
cultural_pressure_fields.projection_use: Choices should trade consumables, body margin, custody, time, and evidence rather than offering consequence-free moral declarations.

cultural_pressure_fields.summary: AU can turn a missed service obligation into parts denial and claimshare pressure while describing each step as separate administration.
cultural_pressure_fields.projection_use: Management pressure should arrive through a readable chain of records and gates, not omnipotent corporate command.

misread_patterns: Treats assembled capacity as theft because no approved product class owns it
Treats one worker's account as sufficient ownership of mixed labor
factional_misread_matrix.projection_use: Let Ilya understand the physical risk while still preferring a single accountable operator and central issue authority.

observer_read: an owner allergic to maintenance responsibility
target_self_read: The only authority able to preserve habitat-wide continuity
misread_patterns: Workers may underestimate how real central inventory scarcity is
Management may mistake practical jokes for lack of strategic discipline
factional_misread_matrix.projection_use: Keep worker contempt precise and practical; Ilya remains competent at moving stock even when the terms are coercive.

role_pressure_fields.summary: An uplifted cephalopod worker whose body, support harness, and route knowledge make the portable bridge physically deployable.
obligations: Keep kit custody from becoming one worker's debt
Leave an assembly another crew can understand
failure_modes: Spending personal oxygenation margin as if it were free
Turning clever distribution into slow emergency response

role_pressure_fields.summary: A baseline human worker whose recognized rescue stock and heavy cart can shelter parts that cephalopod reach alone cannot carry through administrative gates.
obligations: Protect the crew's own claimshare access
available_masks: bad joke told to a worse form
failure_modes: Letting baseline grievance block mixed-worker safety

role_pressure_fields.summary: A local authority who can release or recall stock and convert a claimshare freeze into a repayment schedule, but cannot physically substitute for the workers who deploy the kit.
failure_modes: Removing local reserve to improve central control
Making the unsafe restart look administratively clean
Treating competence as an issue-authority problem

known_context.text: Teth knows local body-support limits, component custody, Kappa route geometry, and what the bypass can physically buy.

beliefs.text: Teth treats technical mercy as a duty and concentrated ownership as a predictable seizure point.

misreads.text: Teth may underestimate how quickly claimshare holds reach households beyond the work ring.

must_not_know.text: Teth does not know which ending the wider Pallas strikes will earn or every central-store shortage beyond the local notice.

known_context.text: Ilya knows local stock, claimshare levers, the condensate fault, and AU's service-default classification.

beliefs.text: Ilya believes central custody is safer because it produces one accountable issue route.

misreads.text: Ilya may read distributed worker custody as diffuse irresponsibility instead of redundancy against coercive seizure.

must_not_know.text: Ilya cannot see every hidden part location or infer private solidarity from one countersignature.

author_only_boundaries.text: The named stores collar, exact recall notice, claimshare form behavior, and assembly outcome are fixture-local historical elaboration, not a universal AU procedure.
The scene may demonstrate mixed-worker competence and solidarity but must not resolve the full Pallas strikes or declare universal recognition of engineered workers.
